# fossa_team_members (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) ID of the team

### Optional

- `search` (String) Search term to filter team members by username or email

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) Array of team members (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) Email of the user. Can be null when the underlying user record has no email.
- `is_service_account` (Boolean) Whether the user is a service account
- `role_id` (Number) ID of the role assigned to the user in the team
- `user_id` (Number) ID of the user
- `username` (String) Username of the user. Can be null when the underlying user record has no username.
